faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIEST Shibpur Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIEST Shibpur is 23rd September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech. degree in Civil, Water Resources and Hydraulic Engineering, or an allied discipline with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA. SC/ST/PwD candidates need 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA.

faq.question: Q3. Is GATE/NET qualification mandatory for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have qualified for GATE/NET to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIEST Shibpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 32 years. Age relaxations are applicable for OBC (NCL), SC/ST, women, and PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. How will the candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates prior to an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary for the first two years is Rs. 48100 per month (Rs. 37,000 + 30% HRA). For the third year, the salary will be Rs. 54600 per month (Rs. 42,000 + 30% HRA).

faq.question: Q7. How should I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email to Dr. Deep Roy at [email protected]. The email should contain a single PDF of the cover letter, CV, marksheets, and certificates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the project duration for this Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The project duration for this Junior Research Fellow position is up to May 2029.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any desirable qualifications for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, exposure in sediment transport/fluvial hydraulics experimental research/numerical modelling will be considered an added advantage for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIEST Shibpur located?
faq.answer: IIEST Shibpur is located in Shibpur, West Bengal, with the pincode 711103.
